review_candidates.title: MSP IT Support Technician
review_candidates.description: MSP IT Support Technician Technology Solutions | Tucson, Arizona Full-Time | On-Site | $45,000–$65,000 per year Technology Solutions is looking for a motivated, client-focused IT Support Technician to join our Tucson team. For nearly two decades, Technology Solutions has provided managed IT services and technology support to businesses throughout Arizona and New Mexico. We work closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, helping them solve day-to-day technology problems, maintain reliable systems, improve security, and make better technology decisions. This is not a high-volume call center position where technicians follow scripts and rush users off the phone. Our technicians build relationships with the people they support, learn how each client’s business operates, and take real ownership of resolving issues. You will work across a variety of clients, industries, systems, and technologies, so no two days are exactly the same. This position is designed for an IT professional with at least two years of hands-on support experience who is ready to step into an established service desk, independently manage client issues, and take problems from initial diagnosis through resolution. You do not need to know every technology you encounter. You do need to be comfortable troubleshooting unfamiliar problems, asking good questions, researching solutions, communicating clearly, and knowing when to collaborate or escalate. What You’ll Do Your primary responsibility will be supporting our clients and resolving technical issues from initial contact through completion. You will work directly with end users, manage a steady flow of service tickets, collaborate with other technicians, and help maintain the technology environments our clients depend on every day. In this role, you will: Troubleshoot and resolve workstation, software, printing, network, mobile device, and peripheral issues Provide both remote and on-site technical support Take ownership of assigned tickets and follow issues through to resolution Keep clients informed throughout the troubleshooting process Document troubleshooting steps, system changes, and resolutions clearly and accurately Support Microsoft 365 applications, accounts, licensing, permissions, and common administrative tasks Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding, including account creation, access changes, device preparation, and documentation Support Windows workstations and Windows Server environments Work with Active Directory, Group Policy, file permissions, DNS, and DHCP Troubleshoot basic to mid-level networking issues involving firewalls, switches, wireless access points, VLANs, VPNs, and internet connectivity Install and configure software, perform system updates, apply patches, and assist with routine endpoint maintenance Work with software vendors, internet service providers, and other third parties to resolve client issues Identify issues that require escalation and provide complete documentation of the troubleshooting already performed Participate in a shared, rotating after-hours on-call schedule for urgent client issues The goal is not simply to close tickets. It is to solve problems thoroughly, communicate clearly, and leave clients confident that their issue was handled correctly. What We’re Looking For: We are looking for someone who combines a strong technical foundation with excellent communication, organization, and follow-through. Successful technicians in this role are able to independently resolve most routine client issues, recognize when escalation is appropriate, and keep both clients and teammates informed throughout the process. Qualified candidates should have: At least two years of professional IT support, help desk, desktop support, or systems support experience Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, user accounts, applications, and network connectivity Experience supporting Windows workstations in a business environment Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and common administrative functions Working familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, file permissions, DNS, and DHCP A practical understanding of TCP/IP networking, VPNs, wireless networking, firewalls, switches, and VLANs Experience supporting printers, scanners, mobile devices, and other common business technology The ability to manage multiple tickets and priorities while maintaining attention to detail Strong written and verbal communication skills The ability to explain technical issues clearly to nontechnical users A professional and client-focused approach to support The ability to work independently while knowing when to collaborate or escalate Strong documentation and organizational habits An understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals and the importance of protecting client systems and data A valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for occasional travel to local client sites The right person for this role will be dependable, motivated, curious, and willing to take ownership. We value technicians who remain calm under pressure, communicate proactively, and are willing to work through a problem rather than stop at the first obstacle. Experience That Will Help You Stand Out: The following experience is not required, but it may help you contribute more quickly in this role: Previous experience working for a managed services provider or supporting multiple business environments Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity, or cloud-based user management Microsoft Intune or other endpoint management platforms Remote monitoring and management tools VMware, Hyper-V, or Proxmox Remote Desktop Services, terminal servers, or virtual desktop environments Firewall configuration and troubleshooting Routing, subnetting, VLANs, and access rules PowerShell, scripting, or workflow automation Cybersecurity tools and practices, including EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, and endpoint security Microsoft, CompTIA, or other relevant industry certifications Certifications and college degrees are welcome, but we place significant value on demonstrated technical ability, troubleshooting skills, and real-world experience. If you have strong hands-on experience, good judgment, and a history of supporting users effectively, we encourage you to apply. Why Join Technology Solutions? Working at an MSP provides exposure to a much wider range of technologies and business environments than many traditional internal IT positions. Because we support complete client environments rather than a single application or technology, this role provides opportunities to work with: Microsoft cloud services Windows servers and workstations Networking and firewalls Cybersecurity platforms Endpoint management Virtualization Business applications Automation and scripting A wide range of client environments and industries Technicians who demonstrate strong ability, initiative, and judgment have opportunities to take on increasingly complex technical work and expand into additional areas of IT. You will work alongside an experienced and collaborative team that shares information, helps one another solve difficult problems, and takes pride in providing dependable service. We invest in the tools and systems our technicians need to work effectively, and we value practical ability, good judgment, curiosity, accountability, and a willingness to learn. Benefits: Technology Solutions offers a competitive benefits package that includes: Health insurance Dental insurance Vision insurance Term life insurance Paid holidays Paid vacation SIMPLE IRA retirement plan with company contribution match Opportunities for professional development and continued technical growth

review_candidates.title: Network Administrator
review_candidates.description: The name Sotera Health was inspired by Soteria, the Greek goddess of safety, and reflects the Company’s unwavering commitment to its mission, Safeguarding Global Health®. Sotera Health Company is a leading global provider of mission-critical sterilization and lab testing and advisory services for the healthcare industry. With a combined tenure across our businesses of nearly 200 years and our industry recognized scientific and technological expertise, we help to ensure the safety of millions of patients and healthcare practitioners around the world every year. Across our 64 facilities worldwide, we have over 3,000 employees who are dedicated to safety and quality. We are a trusted partner to more than 5,800 customers in over 50 countries, including more than 40 of the top 50 medical device companies and 9 of the top 10 pharmaceutical companies. About Us The name Sotera was inspired by the Greek goddess of safety, Soteria, and reflects the Company’s unwavering commitment to global health. As the global leader in mission-critical services to ensure the safety of healthcare, Sotera Health has 64 facilities in 13 countries and provides rigorous lab services, comprehensive sterilization solutions, and expert advisory services to the medical device, pharmaceutical, and food industries. We are a trusted partner to more than 5,800 customers in over 50 countries. Our customers include more than 40 of the top 50 medical device companies and eight of the top ten global pharmaceutical companies (based on revenue). Across our 64 facilities worldwide, we have nearly 3,000 employees who are dedicated to safety and quality. We completed our initial public offering and listed our shares on the Nasdaq in November 2020. Job Summary You will be responsible for supporting and maintaining the Sotera Health network infrastructure, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable operations. This role builds on foundational network support experience and includes increased ownership of network systems, independent troubleshooting, and active participation in infrastructure projects. You will work closely with senior network staff while contributing to the design, implementation, and optimization of network services across the enterprise. Essential Job Functions Provide Tier 2 support for network and telecommunications systems, troubleshooting and resolving connectivity, performance, and configuration issues. Configure, deploy, and maintain network hardware and software, including switches, routers, wireless systems, firewalls, and related infrastructure components. Monitor network performance and availability, proactively identifying and addressing issues to minimize downtime and service disruption. Participate in the implementation of network upgrades, patches, and infrastructure changes in accordance with IT change management processes. Assist in the design and improvement of network solutions to support business requirements and evolving infrastructure needs. Maintain accurate and up-to-date network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, and standard operating procedures. Support network-related projects, contributing to planning, execution, and validation of implemented solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams and business stakeholders to support operational and project-based initiatives. Act as an escalation point for junior staff on routine issues and provide guidance as needed. Coordinate with vendors for basic support cases, hardware replacements, and issue resolution. Ensure adherence to security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements in all network-related activities. Perform other duties as needed to support IT infrastructure and business operations. Qualifications EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred. Equivalent experience in enterprise network environments will be considered in lieu of a degree. Certifications such as CompTIA Network+, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or similar are highly desirable. Experience/Skills 3–5 years of experience in enterprise network administration, infrastructure support, or IT operations. Strong understanding of core networking concepts, including switching, routing, TCP/IP, wireless networking, and basic firewall configurations. Experience managing and supporting enterprise network environments, including LAN/WAN and wireless infrastructure. Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve network issues using established tools and methodologies. Familiarity with network monitoring, performance analysis, and basic capacity planning. Working knowledge of network security principles, including segmentation, access control, and secure configurations. Experience supporting network infrastructure changes and participating in project-based work. Strong documentation and organizational skills to maintain accurate system records and procedures. Effective communication skills for collaboration with technical teams and business users. Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and take on increasing responsibility with limited supervision. Physical Requirements Ability to remain seated or stand at a computer workstation for the majority of the workday, with occasional movement between office and lab environments. Ability to lift and move network equipment as needed. Other Requirements Ability to travel to sites to support network installations, troubleshooting, and project work (up to 20%). Sotera Health goes to market through its three best-in-class businesses – Sterigenics®, Nordion® and Nelson Labs®. Sterigenics is a leading global provider of outsourced terminal sterilization and irradiation services for the medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety and advanced applications markets. Nordion is the leading global provider of Co-60 and gamma irradiators, which are key components to the gamma sterilization process. Nelson Labs is a global leader in outsourced microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries.

review_candidates.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description In this role, you will lead complex technical programs supporting Oracle’s strategic GPU customers through large-scale, multi-year capacity ramps. You will partner with customer engineering teams and Oracle’s cloud infrastructure, networking, engineering, operations, and support organizations to ensure reliable Day 2 operations, resolve critical issues, and drive successful expansion of GPU environments. You will apply strong technical judgment to coordinate troubleshooting across GPU infrastructure, network, storage, capacity, and observability systems; establish operational readiness and escalation mechanisms; and translate customer needs into scalable process, tooling, and product improvements. Success requires the ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and executive stakeholders, and lead cross-functional teams through high-impact customer issues. Responsibilities This role provides senior technical program leadership for Oracle’s strategic GPU customers during complex, multi-year GPU capacity ramps. The Core Infrastructure engineer will operate independently to lead Day 2 operations, resolve critical technical issues, and coordinate delivery across Oracle engineering, networking, cloud operations, support, and customer teams. Own technical program execution and Day 2 operational readiness for strategic GPU customer environments. Lead cross-functional triage and resolution of complex GPU infrastructure, networking, capacity, reliability, and performance issues. Partner directly with customer technical teams to understand requirements, communicate status and risks, and drive joint action plans. Coordinate GPU expansion and deployment activities, including readiness reviews, dependency management, operational runbooks, and risk mitigation. Establish service-health metrics, escalation mechanisms, and clear executive-level operational reporting. Identify systemic issues and recurring customer pain points; translate them into scalable tooling, automation, process, and product improvements. Drive accountability across teams for technical deliverables, milestones, issue resolution, and customer commitments. Provide technical mentorship and escalation leadership that strengthens the team’s broader ability to support strategic GPU customers. Qualifications Disclaimer: Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements. Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity. review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Spaceplane
review_candidates.description: Join us in developing a remotely operated reusable spaceplane that combines the demanding performance of a rocket with the operational discipline of an aircraft. We're looking for an experienced Systems Engineer who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex technical problems, and driving engineering decisions across multidisciplinary teams. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can lead from the front and help shape both the vehicle and the way we engineer it. If you want a narrow, heavily structured role, this is probably not for you. We are looking for someone practical, organised, and capable of taking ownership in a fast-moving environment. What You'll Do Take Ownership of Vehicle Functions Take end-to-end ownership of one or more vehicle functions or systems. Define functional behaviour, requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification approaches. Drive technical decisions and work closely with propulsion, structures, avionics, GNC, software, operations, and certification teams. Establish verification plans and support execution throughout the development lifecycle to deliver integrated vehicle capabilities. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers working within your functional areas. Lead Aircraft System Safety Lead Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) for your assigned functional areas. Develop system-level safety requirements and ensure hazards are effectively mitigated. Perform or contribute to Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Common Cause Analysis (CCA), and other system safety activities. Support the development of safety cases and certification evidence where required. Demonstrate System Reliability and Assurance A key responsibility of this role is ensuring that the reliability statements identified through Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) are supported by credible engineering evidence. Translate reliability allocations and safety objectives from FHA and other safety analyses into practical verification and qualification activities. Define appropriate combinations of testing, analysis, inspection, similarity, and operational evidence to support reliability claims. Develop qualification and environmental test programmes by deriving realistic vibration, shock, thermal, pressure, and other environmental conditions from expected operational use. Lead qualification and reliability demonstration activities, turning certification and safety objectives into practical engineering programmes. Work closely with design engineers to ensure reliability is designed into systems from the outset and demonstrated through robust engineering evidence. Help establish effective approaches for qualification, reliability demonstration, and engineering assurance across the spaceplane programme. Provide technical justification to support high-confidence reliability claims for critical vehicle functions. What We're Looking For You are an experienced engineer who takes ownership, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable making sound technical decisions in complex environments. We expect applicants to bring strong experience in at least two or three of the following areas: Systems engineering for complex aerospace or other safety-critical systems. Ownership of system functions, including requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification. Practical qualification and reliability demonstration of structural, mechanical, electrical, or avionics systems. Functional Hazard Assessment (FHA). Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Common Cause Analysis (CCA), or reliability engineering. Environmental qualification testing, including development of test requirements and profiles. Flight test, vehicle integration, verification, and validation. Aircraft, spacecraft, launch vehicle, advanced unmanned aircraft, or other highly integrated safety-critical systems. What Makes You Successful You quickly understand the strengths and capabilities of a team, adapt your approach accordingly, and raise the technical standard by leading through example. You naturally take ownership and drive work through to completion. You can understand complex systems and make pragmatic engineering decisions. You enjoy building practical engineering solutions rather than simply following process. You communicate clearly and influence technical direction through sound engineering judgement. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams deliver higher-quality engineering outcomes. Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to help develop a first-of-its-kind aerospace vehicle operating at the intersection of aviation and spaceflight. You'll have genuine ownership of critical vehicle functions, work alongside highly capable engineers, and help solve technical challenges that don't exist anywhere else in the industry. Your work will directly influence how we demonstrate safety, reliability, and operational readiness as we take the vehicle from development into routine operations. Diversity & Inclusion At Dawn Aerospace, we believe that diverse teams build better solutions. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences are valued and supported to do their best work. About Dawn Aerospace Dawn Aerospace is a space transportation company with a purpose. Our Mission Is To Enable The Next Generation Of Space Users By Providing More Sustainable And Scalable Ways To Access And Move Around In Space. We Believe This Access, In The Form Of a Transportation Network, Will Fundamentally Change What’s Possible From Space. We Currently Focus On Three Areas Of Space Transportation In-space propulsion We're a leading supplier of turnkey green propulsion systems for various classes of satellites. Our systems utilise safe, accessible propellants and we have over 170 of these propulsion units on more than 40 operational satellites already. A further 200 units are in production. In-space servicing Coupled with our propulsion expertise, we are ensuring that our customers' satellites are refuellable. In the coming years, Dawn will offer a refueling service to enable life extension of customer satellites. This new market is aligned with our sustainability goal to ensue a clean and safe space for everyone! Spaceplane We are developing the fastest and highest-flying aircraft ever to take off from a runway, combining the extreme performance of rocket propulsion with the reusability of conventional airplanes to enable high-frequency, low-cost access to sub-orbital space. Our international teams are distributed across four locations: the Netherlands, France, New Zealand, and the USA. Apply for this Job Important! If you think you have what it takes but are unsure that you check every box, we still want to hear from you. To all recruitment agencies : Dawn Aerospace does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job’s alias, our employees, or any other company location. Dawn Aerospace will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

GND sits at the intersection of infrastructure engineering, capacity planning, and physical build execution; translating demand signals into commissioned network capacity that AWS customers and services depend on. This role sits inside the GND APAC Planning function and owns the end-to-end planning and coordination of Room build deliverables across one of AWS's most complex and fastest-growing regions. APAC spans multiple clusters across countries including Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Australia, and India; each with its own regulatory environment, supply chain dynamics, construction cadence, and operational context. No two builds are identical, and the planning function is expected to absorb that complexity without passing it downstream. This role requires someone who operates with a high degree of ownership, communicates with clarity across technical and non-technical audiences, and builds the kind of cross-functional relationships that make complex, multi-party delivery program run without friction. You manage the full planning lifecycle from project intake through to delivery and are accountable for the on-time performance of every active build in your portfolio. You are always ahead of your portfolio; you identify risks early, quantify their impact, and bring a mitigation plan before anyone asks. You do not surface a problem without also presenting a path forward. People Leadership You lead a team of network deployment planners. You assign projects, manage backlogs, set clear priorities, and hold your team accountable to milestones. You develop your planners through regular coaching, stretch assignments, and direct feedback. You treat the growth of your team as a core deliverable of the role, not a secondary responsibility. Handover Quality You own the accuracy and completeness of planning artefacts at handover into Deploy. You treat Deploy friction as a signal to improve upstream planning and take accountability for resolving it at the source. A clean handover is a non-negotiable standard, not a best-effort outcome. You understand their constraints, anticipate their needs, and work proactively to align dependence before they become blockers. You track milestone completion rates, documentation accuracy, and project health; identify trends, escalate early, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence. Ownership & community impact: A strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and initiative — turning challenges into durable engineering solutions and diving into unfamiliar systems — along with contributions to open-source infrastructure/observability projects, conference talks, or active participation in the wider SRE community. review_candidates.description: We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and quality-focused QA Tester to ensure software applications meet functional, usability, performance, and quality standards before release. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to identify, document, and communicate software issues effectively. Responsibilities Execute manual and automated tests to verify software functionality and quality. Review requirements, specifications, and user stories to develop appropriate test scenarios. Create and maintain test cases, test scripts, and testing documentation. Identify, document, and track software bugs and defects. Reproduce reported issues and provide clear steps and supporting information. Perform functional, regression, integration, usability, and exploratory testing. Verify bug fixes and ensure issues are properly resolved. Collaborate with developers, product managers, designers, and other teams to resolve defects. Participate in testing throughout the software development lifecycle. Perform cross-browser, cross-platform, and device testing when required. Validate application behavior against business and technical requirements. Maintain accurate records of test results, defects, and testing progress. Communicate testing status, risks, and quality concerns to relevant stakeholders. Assist with user acceptance testing and release validation. Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, and quality standards. Support continuous improvement of QA practices and documentation. Required Skills Strong understanding of software testing and quality assurance principles. Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities. Experience creating and executing test cases and test scenarios. Ability to identify, reproduce, and document software defects clearly. Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools. Understanding of software development lifecycles and QA processes. Basic knowledge of APIs, databases, SQL, or web technologies is beneficial. Familiarity with regression, functional, integration, and exploratory testing. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical teams. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple testing activities and meet deadlines. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment. Requirements Previous experience in QA testing, software testing, quality assurance, or a similar role. Experience creating and executing manual test cases. Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking software defects. Familiarity with tools such as Jira, TestRail, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms. Understanding of web and software application testing processes. Experience performing regression and functional testing. Strong computer and digital skills. Ability to analyze requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail. Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and professionally. Reliable internet connection and a suitable setup for remote work. Professional, analytical, dependable, and quality-focused attitude. English proficiency is required if the position involves working with English-speaking teams or technical documentation. By applying to this position, we’ll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.

review_candidates.title: Senior Manager of Project Controls
review_candidates.description: Description Title: Senior Manager, Project Controls Department: Operational Excellence Location: Houston, TX Supervisor: VP of Project Controls FLSA Status: Exempt Position Status: Full-Time Work Status: Remote SENIOR MANAGER, PROJECT CONTROLS Hanwha Qcells USA Corp (Qcells USA), headquartered in Houston, TX, specializes in providing utility-scale modules, solar photovoltaic (PV), and battery energy storage systems (BESS) project development, along with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services for solar and BESS projects nationwide. Qcells USA delivers comprehensive turnkey solutions encompassing the entire utility-scale project lifecycle. By choosing Qcells USA for turnkey solutions, customers can reduce uncertainty and risk, leading to enhanced investment returns and contributing to a more sustainable future. Qcells USA’s complete turnkey solutions seamlessly integrate the expertise of our Development, Module, and EPC teams, while ensuring close coordination with other vital internal groups such as Project Finance, Systems Integration, and Legal. This collaborative approach ensures that Qcells USA projects deliver exceptional value and performance. With several multi-billion-dollar investments, Qcells is pioneering the establishment of the only complete module supply chain in the U.S., including the expansion of our Georgia module manufacturing facility, which stands as the largest in the Western Hemisphere. As an integral part of the global Qcells brand, Qcells USA benefits from a legacy of excellence in photovoltaic manufacturing. Qcells is renowned worldwide for its high-performance, superior-quality solar cells and modules. With dual headquarters in Seoul, South Korea (Global Executive HQ) and Thalheim, Germany (Technology & Innovation HQ), Qcells operates under the umbrella of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 company and one of the top 8 business conglomerates in South Korea. Summary The Senior Manager of Project Controls will drive the commercial success of our utility scale solar and BESS projects. This role will directly manage a dedicated team of Commercial Managers and Project Accountants, focusing on the financial and contractual aspects of Self-Perform Solar Projects. The ideal candidate will be passionate about renewable energy, possess strong communication and influential skills, and have a proven track record in project management, experience in construction cost control, cost forecasting, CPM scheduling, negotiation skills, risk and opportunity identification and management, change management, and contract management. The role requires constant evaluation of both internal resources and subcontractor contributions to the projects' success, addressing any contractual issues rapidly to maintain project momentum. The successful candidate will have regular collaboration with the internal Project Controls team, construction management senior leaders, and operations teams to implement tools and processes throughout the active construction projects. This position reports to the VP of Project Controls, or another senior management personnel that the CEO of the Company may designate. This position is remote, working out of your home and traveling to the jobsites. Working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00am to 5:00pm or 9:00am to 6:00pm. This position requires to travel up to 25% of the time. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Essential Job Function & Responsibilities Lead a team of Commercial Managers and Project Accountants, overseeing their work on Self-Perform Solar Projects. Collaborate with project directors, project managers, and construction managers to meet project objectives within constraints. Participate as a key stakeholder in negotiations for subcontracts, ensuring favorable terms and compliance with company standards. Oversee and conduct comprehensive assessments to identify project risks and opportunities, devising strategies to mitigate risks while capitalizing on opportunities. Oversee and manage change orders, ensuring they are accurately documented, assessed for impact, and implemented effectively for upstream and downstream commitments. Develop and implement strategies to ensure all projects adhere to contractual obligations and company policies. Regularly evaluate internal resource and subcontractor performance to guarantee adherence to project execution strategies. Address and resolve any upstream or downstream contractual disputes or issues promptly to minimize the impact on project timelines and budgets. Prepare and present detailed monthly executive reports, including variance analysis, risk logs, project summary reports, forecasts, and change logs. Conduct weekly and monthly reviews of deliverables for project management, providing constructive feedback and development plans to enhance team performance and capabilities. Implement and maintain project cost control plans and procedures. Partake as a key stakeholder in project schedule development and review, including critical path management and progress tracking. Manage project budgets, including cost tracking and forecasting. Engage with clients and stakeholders to align expectations with project goals and communicate invoicing, cash flows, and change management. Ensure all projects are compliant with the business’ set standards in reporting and project management means and methods. Perform other duties and special projects, as assigned by Senior Management. Regular attendance, in accordance with company's attendance policy and supervisory assignment, is an essential job duty requirement for this position. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in related field; MBA preferred, or 5+ years work experience in a related field. At least 2 years of experience in project management, or a cost control function, preferably within the renewable energy sector. Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple tasks and deadlines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management software, and other relevant tools Have insight to highlight key risk factors and advise EPC cost estimates. Experience with current solar EPC tools and processes and remain current on best practices and trends in the industry. Demonstrated track record of initiating programs that lead to significant cost reduction and/or performance improvement. Capability to interact with leadership cross-culturally, both within and outside the organization Have both a long-term strategic perspective and near-term action orientation, and a strong desire to continuously improve and push limits. Strong team player with a high degree of professionalism in which one conducts self at all times. Willingness to travel as required, up to 25%. PHYSICAL DEMANDS Stationary Position: frequently remains stationary up to 90% of the time and sitting up to 8 hours in a day Move/Traverse: infrequently bend, stand, stoop and/or walk Carry Weight: infrequently carry weight and/or lift objects (light to heavy) weighing up to 10 pounds Hearing and Speech: frequently communicates with the ability to hear and talk on a regular basis with employees, coworkers, and all personnel matters; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations Sight: frequent use of sight to detect images on computer, office documents, and office objects near and far Climb: occasionally ascends/descends on stairway to get to office upper and lower floors Travel: up to 50% as needed WORK ENVIRONMENT Regular professional, office business setting Noise level ranges from low to moderate (if in office setting) Noise level ranges from moderate to high (if on construction worksite) In accordance with the Office Mobilization Plan (OMP), this position may transition to an onsite or hybrid work arrangement based on evolving business needs and at the discretion of the Head of Department. Analysis of gas/liquid propulsion monopropellant and bi-propellant components/subassemblies into gas and liquid propulsion subsystems. Analyze the stability and robustness of GNC algorithms using control theory and Monte Carlo simulations. Determines technical objectives and develop innovative, practical solutions to advanced technical engineering problems. Hands-on work environment and high level of interaction with system components. Oversee prototype builds and implement lessons learned into design. Professional Qualifications Must have a thorough understanding of engineering concepts, principles, codes, and theory; experience demonstrating a broad application of those concepts; and expanding knowledge of principles, concepts, theory, and practices in related technical specialties. review_candidates.description: Equans est à la recherche d’un(e) Chef(fe) de groupe – Automatisation/PLC, développement applications TI et soutien opérationnel TI pour l’aéroport de Montréal! Le groupe Equans est un leader mondial du secteur des énergies et services. Le Groupe est implanté dans 20 pays et compte 90 000 collaborateurs répartis sur 5 continents. Equans conçoit, installe et fournit des solutions sur mesure pour améliorer les équipements, les systèmes et les processus techniques de ses clients et optimiser leur utilisation dans le contexte de leurs transitions énergétique, industrielle et numérique. Depuis 2022, Equans fait partie du groupe Bouygues. Actif au Canada et aux Etats-Unis depuis plus de 30 ans, Equans Services est le partenaire des entreprises, industriels et institutions qui souhaitent tendre vers des bâtiments plus connectés, gérer leurs installations de manière efficace et réduire leur empreinte carbone. Nous concevons, installons et maintenons des solutions sur mesure pour améliorer les installations, les systèmes et les infrastructures de nos clients. Nos offres principales se concentrent dans les domaines suivants : Gestion intégrée d’actifs et d’installations (Integrated Facility Management) ; Opération et maintenance de bâtiments et d’équipements ; Solutions d’efficacité énergétiques et plan de décarbonation ; Automatisation des bâtiments ; Solutions pour le transport et la mobilité. Son rôle est d’assurer le leadership organisationnel et transversal du groupe; elle n’a pas à être l’experte technique de chacune des disciplines, mais doit être en mesure d’en comprendre les enjeux, d’arbitrer les priorités et de mobiliser les expertises appropriées. Embaucher, mobiliser, encadrer, développer et évaluer les employés et les gestionnaires ou superviseur(e)s du groupe; Mettre en œuvre et maintenir la matrice de compétences des trois disciplines pour les niveaux junior, intermédiaire, sénior et expert; Établir, pour chaque employé(e), des objectifs de développement, des plans de formation et des parcours de progression fondés sur les compétences, l’expérience et l’autonomie attendues; Organiser le mentorat, le transfert de connaissances, la relève des postes critiques et la polyvalence entre les équipes, en s’appuyant sur les séniors et les expert(e)s; Reconnaître les expert(e)s comme autorités techniques de leur domaine et instaurer des mécanismes de revue, d’approbation et d’escalade pour les décisions à risque élevé; Définir avec les responsables techniques les standards d’architecture, de programmation, de cybersécurité, de documentation, de tests, de mise en service et de soutien; Mettre en place une gouvernance intégrée des demandes, incidents, problèmes, changements et projets, avec des priorités, responsabilités et niveaux d’escalade clairement établis; Assurer la disponibilité, la fiabilité et la performance des systèmes critiques, ainsi que la préparation et l’exécution des plans de contingence; Veiller à la qualité des analyses de causes fondamentales et au déploiement durable des correctifs et plans de fiabilisation; Superviser les activités techniques et les projets touchant les automates/PLC, les réseaux informatiques, le SCADA, les applications, les bases de données, le reporting, les interfaces et les systèmes de traitement bagages BHS; Arbitrer les priorités entre les besoins opérationnels immédiats, les projets d’amélioration continue, la cybersécurité, l’innovation et les projets de transformation; Piloter la performance du groupe au moyen d’indicateurs de service, de fiabilité, de qualité, de sécurité, de livraison, de développement des compétences et de satisfaction client; Gérer la relation avec le client, les partenaires, les fournisseurs et les autres départements, et communiquer clairement les risques, les décisions et les plans d’action; Préparer les offres de service et les soumissions, soutenir les approbations internes et contribuer à la croissance et à la rentabilité des activités aéroportuaires; une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience pourra être considérée; Expérience significative en gestion d’équipes techniques multidisciplinaires dans un environnement opérationnel critique; Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de superviseurs, leaders techniques ou experts, ainsi que dans le développement d’équipes comprenant plusieurs niveaux de séniorité; Capacité à gouverner un portefeuille combinant opérations, soutien, fiabilisation, cybersécurité, amélioration continue et projets; Compréhension générale de plusieurs des domaines suivants : PLC et réseaux informatiques, SCADA, applications, bases de données, analytique/reporting, intégration de systèmes, soutien de production et systèmes de traitement bagages BHS; new_matches.description: MSP IT Support Technician Technology Solutions | Tucson, Arizona Full-Time | On-Site | $45,000–$65,000 per year Technology Solutions is looking for a motivated, client-focused IT Support Technician to join our Tucson team. For nearly two decades, Technology Solutions has provided managed IT services and technology support to businesses throughout Arizona and New Mexico. We work closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, helping them solve day-to-day technology problems, maintain reliable systems, improve security, and make better technology decisions. This is not a high-volume call center position where technicians follow scripts and rush users off the phone. Our technicians build relationships with the people they support, learn how each client’s business operates, and take real ownership of resolving issues. You will work across a variety of clients, industries, systems, and technologies, so no two days are exactly the same. This position is designed for an IT professional with at least two years of hands-on support experience who is ready to step into an established service desk, independently manage client issues, and take problems from initial diagnosis through resolution. You do not need to know every technology you encounter. You do need to be comfortable troubleshooting unfamiliar problems, asking good questions, researching solutions, communicating clearly, and knowing when to collaborate or escalate. What You’ll Do Your primary responsibility will be supporting our clients and resolving technical issues from initial contact through completion. You will work directly with end users, manage a steady flow of service tickets, collaborate with other technicians, and help maintain the technology environments our clients depend on every day. In this role, you will: Troubleshoot and resolve workstation, software, printing, network, mobile device, and peripheral issues Provide both remote and on-site technical support Take ownership of assigned tickets and follow issues through to resolution Keep clients informed throughout the troubleshooting process Document troubleshooting steps, system changes, and resolutions clearly and accurately Support Microsoft 365 applications, accounts, licensing, permissions, and common administrative tasks Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding, including account creation, access changes, device preparation, and documentation Support Windows workstations and Windows Server environments Work with Active Directory, Group Policy, file permissions, DNS, and DHCP Troubleshoot basic to mid-level networking issues involving firewalls, switches, wireless access points, VLANs, VPNs, and internet connectivity Install and configure software, perform system updates, apply patches, and assist with routine endpoint maintenance Work with software vendors, internet service providers, and other third parties to resolve client issues Identify issues that require escalation and provide complete documentation of the troubleshooting already performed Participate in a shared, rotating after-hours on-call schedule for urgent client issues The goal is not simply to close tickets. It is to solve problems thoroughly, communicate clearly, and leave clients confident that their issue was handled correctly. What We’re Looking For: We are looking for someone who combines a strong technical foundation with excellent communication, organization, and follow-through. Successful technicians in this role are able to independently resolve most routine client issues, recognize when escalation is appropriate, and keep both clients and teammates informed throughout the process. Qualified candidates should have: At least two years of professional IT support, help desk, desktop support, or systems support experience Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, user accounts, applications, and network connectivity Experience supporting Windows workstations in a business environment Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and common administrative functions Working familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, file permissions, DNS, and DHCP A practical understanding of TCP/IP networking, VPNs, wireless networking, firewalls, switches, and VLANs Experience supporting printers, scanners, mobile devices, and other common business technology The ability to manage multiple tickets and priorities while maintaining attention to detail Strong written and verbal communication skills The ability to explain technical issues clearly to nontechnical users A professional and client-focused approach to support The ability to work independently while knowing when to collaborate or escalate Strong documentation and organizational habits An understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals and the importance of protecting client systems and data A valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for occasional travel to local client sites The right person for this role will be dependable, motivated, curious, and willing to take ownership. We value technicians who remain calm under pressure, communicate proactively, and are willing to work through a problem rather than stop at the first obstacle. Experience That Will Help You Stand Out: The following experience is not required, but it may help you contribute more quickly in this role: Previous experience working for a managed services provider or supporting multiple business environments Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity, or cloud-based user management Microsoft Intune or other endpoint management platforms Remote monitoring and management tools VMware, Hyper-V, or Proxmox Remote Desktop Services, terminal servers, or virtual desktop environments Firewall configuration and troubleshooting Routing, subnetting, VLANs, and access rules PowerShell, scripting, or workflow automation Cybersecurity tools and practices, including EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, and endpoint security Microsoft, CompTIA, or other relevant industry certifications Certifications and college degrees are welcome, but we place significant value on demonstrated technical ability, troubleshooting skills, and real-world experience. If you have strong hands-on experience, good judgment, and a history of supporting users effectively, we encourage you to apply. Why Join Technology Solutions? Working at an MSP provides exposure to a much wider range of technologies and business environments than many traditional internal IT positions. Because we support complete client environments rather than a single application or technology, this role provides opportunities to work with: Microsoft cloud services Windows servers and workstations Networking and firewalls Cybersecurity platforms Endpoint management Virtualization Business applications Automation and scripting A wide range of client environments and industries Technicians who demonstrate strong ability, initiative, and judgment have opportunities to take on increasingly complex technical work and expand into additional areas of IT. You will work alongside an experienced and collaborative team that shares information, helps one another solve difficult problems, and takes pride in providing dependable service. We invest in the tools and systems our technicians need to work effectively, and we value practical ability, good judgment, curiosity, accountability, and a willingness to learn. Benefits: Technology Solutions offers a competitive benefits package that includes: Health insurance Dental insurance Vision insurance Term life insurance Paid holidays Paid vacation SIMPLE IRA retirement plan with company contribution match Opportunities for professional development and continued technical growth

new_matches.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Spaceplane
new_matches.description: Join us in developing a remotely operated reusable spaceplane that combines the demanding performance of a rocket with the operational discipline of an aircraft. We're looking for an experienced Systems Engineer who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex technical problems, and driving engineering decisions across multidisciplinary teams. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can lead from the front and help shape both the vehicle and the way we engineer it. If you want a narrow, heavily structured role, this is probably not for you. We are looking for someone practical, organised, and capable of taking ownership in a fast-moving environment. What You'll Do Take Ownership of Vehicle Functions Take end-to-end ownership of one or more vehicle functions or systems. Define functional behaviour, requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification approaches. Drive technical decisions and work closely with propulsion, structures, avionics, GNC, software, operations, and certification teams. Establish verification plans and support execution throughout the development lifecycle to deliver integrated vehicle capabilities. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers working within your functional areas. Lead Aircraft System Safety Lead Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) for your assigned functional areas. Develop system-level safety requirements and ensure hazards are effectively mitigated. Perform or contribute to Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Common Cause Analysis (CCA), and other system safety activities. Support the development of safety cases and certification evidence where required. Demonstrate System Reliability and Assurance A key responsibility of this role is ensuring that the reliability statements identified through Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) are supported by credible engineering evidence. Translate reliability allocations and safety objectives from FHA and other safety analyses into practical verification and qualification activities. Define appropriate combinations of testing, analysis, inspection, similarity, and operational evidence to support reliability claims. Develop qualification and environmental test programmes by deriving realistic vibration, shock, thermal, pressure, and other environmental conditions from expected operational use. Lead qualification and reliability demonstration activities, turning certification and safety objectives into practical engineering programmes. Work closely with design engineers to ensure reliability is designed into systems from the outset and demonstrated through robust engineering evidence. Help establish effective approaches for qualification, reliability demonstration, and engineering assurance across the spaceplane programme. Provide technical justification to support high-confidence reliability claims for critical vehicle functions. What We're Looking For You are an experienced engineer who takes ownership, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable making sound technical decisions in complex environments. We expect applicants to bring strong experience in at least two or three of the following areas: Systems engineering for complex aerospace or other safety-critical systems. Ownership of system functions, including requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification. Practical qualification and reliability demonstration of structural, mechanical, electrical, or avionics systems. Functional Hazard Assessment (FHA). Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Common Cause Analysis (CCA), or reliability engineering. Environmental qualification testing, including development of test requirements and profiles. Flight test, vehicle integration, verification, and validation. Aircraft, spacecraft, launch vehicle, advanced unmanned aircraft, or other highly integrated safety-critical systems. What Makes You Successful You quickly understand the strengths and capabilities of a team, adapt your approach accordingly, and raise the technical standard by leading through example. You naturally take ownership and drive work through to completion. You can understand complex systems and make pragmatic engineering decisions. You enjoy building practical engineering solutions rather than simply following process. You communicate clearly and influence technical direction through sound engineering judgement. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams deliver higher-quality engineering outcomes. Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to help develop a first-of-its-kind aerospace vehicle operating at the intersection of aviation and spaceflight. You'll have genuine ownership of critical vehicle functions, work alongside highly capable engineers, and help solve technical challenges that don't exist anywhere else in the industry. Your work will directly influence how we demonstrate safety, reliability, and operational readiness as we take the vehicle from development into routine operations. Diversity & Inclusion At Dawn Aerospace, we believe that diverse teams build better solutions. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences are valued and supported to do their best work. About Dawn Aerospace Dawn Aerospace is a space transportation company with a purpose. Our Mission Is To Enable The Next Generation Of Space Users By Providing More Sustainable And Scalable Ways To Access And Move Around In Space. We Believe This Access, In The Form Of a Transportation Network, Will Fundamentally Change What’s Possible From Space. We Currently Focus On Three Areas Of Space Transportation In-space propulsion We're a leading supplier of turnkey green propulsion systems for various classes of satellites. Our systems utilise safe, accessible propellants and we have over 170 of these propulsion units on more than 40 operational satellites already. A further 200 units are in production. In-space servicing Coupled with our propulsion expertise, we are ensuring that our customers' satellites are refuellable. In the coming years, Dawn will offer a refueling service to enable life extension of customer satellites. This new market is aligned with our sustainability goal to ensue a clean and safe space for everyone! Spaceplane We are developing the fastest and highest-flying aircraft ever to take off from a runway, combining the extreme performance of rocket propulsion with the reusability of conventional airplanes to enable high-frequency, low-cost access to sub-orbital space. Our international teams are distributed across four locations: the Netherlands, France, New Zealand, and the USA. Apply for this Job Important! Champion AI-assisted engineering practices, including coding agents and LLM-powered tooling, to accelerate day-to-day engineering workflows. Partner with Cloud, Platform, Security, and AI/ML teams to embed SRE best practices, define SLOs and error budgets, and influence architecture early in the design cycle. Mentor engineers, raise engineering standards through design and code review, and help build a strong reliability culture in the India organisation. BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Proven experience acting as an Incident Commander or leading major incident response in complex, high-availability environments. Deep understanding of distributed systems, monitoring, and reliability engineering principles — SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and graceful degradation. Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java ) to build production-grade automation and tooling. Hands-on expertise with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Solid experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (e.g., Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines. Strong Linux/Unix and networking fundamentals, plus expertise in observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Working knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) — SQL, indexing, and query optimisation. Experience or familiarity with AI/ML concepts (e.g., LLMs, anomaly detection, or data-driven operations) applied to operational workflows. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief executives during high-pressure incidents and influence senior technical stakeholders. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Building & applying AI to operations: Hands-on experience building incident management or automation platforms (ChatOps, workflow orchestration, alert intelligence) and applying AI to operations — intelligent triage, RCA generation, and signal correlation — with a demonstrable track record of reducing MTTD and MTTR, backed by numbers. new_matches.description: Job Summary General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems (GA-EMS) designs and manufactures first-of-a-kind electromagnetic and electric power generation systems. GA-EMS' expanding portfolio of specialized products and integrated system solutions support critical fleet, space systems and satellites, missile defense, power and energy, and process and monitoring applications for defense, industrial, and commercial customers worldwide. Join our Mechanical Engineering team as a Mechanical Engineering Manager and help advance satellite development and orbital operations. We are seeking an experienced engineering leader who can manage a multidisciplinary team and guide work across structures, thermal systems, fluids, and guidance, navigation, and control (GNC). This is an exciting opportunity to lead technically challenging programs and contribute to the success of advanced space systems. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Manage a team to develop engineering solutions that require creative designs, detailed analysis, investigation, and resolution of routine engineering problems while fostering a collaborative team environment. Engage in the development and integration of spacecraft and payload systems, high-energy lasers, electro-optical systems, and other complex technologies. Ability to perform structural and dynamic analysis on components, spacecraft and launch vehicle systems. Analysis of gas/liquid propulsion monopropellant and bi-propellant components/subassemblies into gas and liquid propulsion subsystems. Manage the analysis and optimization of spacecraft fluid systems, with a focus on propulsion, slosh dynamics, plume impingement and aerophysics. Perform advanced simulations and modeling of fluid behavior in spacecraft environments, including zero-gravity, extreme temperature variations, and vacuum conditions. Experience with the design, analysis, build, and test of advanced space hardware. Apply statistical methods and perform mathematical calculations to evaluate strength and dynamic capabilities. Conduct trades studies for sizing, specification and selection of spacecraft GNC hardware including reaction wheel and torque rod sizing, sensor noise and performance characteristics, redundancy and fault management. Lead architecture development of high fidelity GNC/attitude control algorithms. Establish, maintain and execute satellite altitude control simulation software. Analyze the stability and robustness of GNC algorithms using control theory and Monte Carlo simulations. Determines technical objectives and develop innovative, practical solutions to advanced technical engineering problems. Addresses complex and difficult technical issues requiring highly creative approaches, drawing on advanced engineering concepts. Hands-on work environment and high level of interaction with system components. Oversee prototype builds and implement lessons learned into design. Support business development and Manage IRAD planning and execution Perform resource evaluation, development planning and performance reviews. Support tool evaluation and identify process gaps. We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. Job Qualifications Typically requires a Bachelors, Masters or PhD in engineering or a related technical field as well as eleven or more years of progressively complex engineering experience. May substitute equivalent experience in lieu of education. Experience in managing and leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams is required. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills are required, enabling effective interface with other departments and professionals, representing the organization as a prime technical contact, and providing leadership and guidance to less experienced professionals. Demonstrates extensive technical expertise and application of engineering principles, with the ability to organize, plan, schedule, conduct, and coordinate workloads to meet established deadlines or milestones with some experience in project leadership. Must possess the ability to develop and communicate new concepts; apply them accurately throughout an evolving environment; organize, schedule, and coordinate work phases; and determine the appropriate approach at the task level or, with assistance, at the project level to provide solutions to a range of complex problems. Customer-focused, formulates plans based on the development of innovative new designs in resolving advanced technical engineering problems. Technical Expertise Expertise in structural, thermal, propulsion, and GNC (guidance, navigation, and control) design and analysis is required. Mechanical design experience is strongly preferred. Optical systems, flight systems, or military systems experience is highly desirable. Familiarity with space/launch environments is a plus. Knowledge of aluminum honeycomb panels is advantageous. Exposure to laboratory environments, including materials characterization, materials testing, vibration testing, and failure analysis, is preferred. Proficiency in CAD and FEA (finite element analysis) software such as SolidWorks, ANSYS, NASTRAN, FEMAP, Thermal Desktop, STK, Monte, Basilisk is highly desirable. Experience with Matlab is helpful. Professional Qualifications Must have a thorough understanding of engineering concepts, principles, codes, and theory; experience demonstrating a broad application of those concepts; and expanding knowledge of principles, concepts, theory, and practices in related technical specialties. A Professional Engineering License, original work(s) published in professional engineering journals, and invitations to present one or more original works at engineering symposiums are desirable. Work Environment Must be customer-focused and able to work on a self-initiated basis or in a team environment, with the ability to work extended hours and travel as required. Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance is required. Job Type: Full-Time Salary Salary range: 125,810 - 229,670

Capable of representing the organization as a prime technical contact. Customer-focused and able to formulate plans based on the development of innovative new designs in resolving advanced technical engineering problems. Some travel and extended work schedules may be required. Job Type: Full-Time Salary Salary range: 100,290 - 183,098
